Name: No festival timer
Author: mistyspring
Description:
[size=3]This mod is a fill for [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1172]this github mod idea[/url]. It's meant for accessibility purposes

Initially, this mod supports the egg festival and fishing minigame, but it can be edited to allow mod festivals too.
[/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]For the egg festival: The contest ends on finding all eggs.[/size]
[*][size=3]For the fishing minigame: The contest ends once you get 5 fish.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Festival freeze is on by default, but you can toggle it with F (configurable).


You can request mods' festivals to be included, or add them yourself:

[/size][code]﻿{
﻿"Action":"EditData",
﻿"Target":"Mods/mistyspring.nofestivaltimer/Exclusions",
﻿"Entries":{
﻿ ﻿"ModCustomFestivalID":{
﻿ ﻿ ﻿"IgnoreTimer": true,
﻿ ﻿ ﻿"OnScore": 0, //minimum score to stop at
﻿ ﻿ ﻿"Props": false //if to stop once there's no more props
﻿ ﻿}
﻿}
}
[/code][size=3]

If you like what i do, [url=https://ko-fi.com/mistyspring][b]consider buying me a coffee [/b][b]♥.[/b][/url][/size]
